Industrial Product

V-Rings

A compact auxiliary shaft-sealing option for rotating equipment that needs splash and dust exclusion with simple installation.

V-Rings are all-rubber axial seals that rotate with the shaft and run against a stationary counterface. In practice they are commonly used as cost-effective contaminant barriers and auxiliary seals rather than primary pressure seals.

Shaft Protection

Helps prevent water, dust, and debris from entering rotating assemblies.

Easy Installation

The elastic design can often be stretched over adjacent components during assembly.

Auxiliary Sealing Role

Commonly used to reinforce the protection of bearings and primary shaft seals in dirty or wet environments.
